recommendation.summary: Phase 10 conclusive finding: CDSS officially states Transparency Download Data is updated weekly (FAQ), and downloadstatedata.html notes a regularly published CalHHS copy. Neither statement, nor filename MMDDYYYY (2026-11-15), SPA client versions, HTTP/portal/GIS clocks, or Public Portal docs, provides a verified authoritative ISO export date for a specific DownloadStateData attachment. Keep the publication gate BLOCKED under require-official-iso-export-channel. A draft clarification to cclwebmaster@dss.ca.gov / opendata@cdss.ca.gov is prepared and must not be sent without human approval.
